opening.argument: The presentation prominently offers free Amazon and Flipkart gift cards and earnings of up to 1 lakh per month while directing viewers to an app and referral code. New users are told to register with their name and phone number, and entering the referral code is tied to an extra benefit. The app then presents game participation and stated entry amounts as a way to double money, including claims that 10 rupees can become 20 and 1,000 can become 2,000. Withdrawal is offered only after KYC, adding a further information requirement to the promised reward process. These are low-barrier acquisition and reward claims supported by registration, referral, game, and withdrawal instructions. The records do not establish that any reward was delivered, that a payment succeeded, or what information KYC collects.
